description: Tightly scoped: Renovate only watches the LLM e2e harness's pinned Claude Code CLI version. No other deps in this repo are managed here — Go modules and other manifests are explicitly ignored to prevent runaway PRs. Bumps follow npm's `stable` dist-tag (deliberately lagged from `latest`); see test/e2e-llm/README.md for the bump procedure.

prBodyNotes: Before merging: run `./run-all.sh` twice from `test/e2e-llm/` against the candidate version, confirm 16/16 pass both times. See the README's bump procedure.
